concepts.purpose_scope_authority: Acquisition/onsite/app surface; brand-scoped

concepts.purpose_scope_authority: Named recurring communication promise, purpose and frequency; brand-scoped

concepts.purpose_scope_authority: Canonical operational subject, not infallible proof of a human

concepts.purpose_scope_authority: Organization-scoped identifier or trusted account subject; Texenda authority for its binding

concepts.purpose_scope_authority: Brand-local classification, never permission

concepts.purpose_scope_authority: Versioned selection expression

concepts.purpose_scope_authority: Stable family of communication semantics

concepts.purpose_scope_authority: Addressable destination or installed subscription

concepts.purpose_scope_authority: Evidence tying an endpoint to a subject/context

concepts.purpose_scope_authority: Append-only evidence of request, confirmation, grant, withdrawal or correction
concepts.identity_lifecycle: Event ID + monotonically applied subject/scope version; recorded/invalidated-by-correction
concepts.relationships: Original source, source time, received time, disclosure version and proof reference

concepts.purpose_scope_authority: Effective affirmative authority for a specific brand/publication-or-purpose/channel and endpoint binding
concepts.relationships: Derived atomically from consent evidence; cannot be edited by raw CRUD

concepts.purpose_scope_authority: Recipient restriction at publication, brand, organization, channel and/or endpoint scope
concepts.identity_lifecycle: ID; effective from authoritative receipt/application; active; scoped fresh reconsent may supersede only explicitly acknowledged restrictions
concepts.relationships: Not the same as endpoint invalidity or a provider block

concepts.purpose_scope_authority: Delivery order, cadence, pause, quiet hours, language; never creates authority
concepts.relationships: Restricts eligible alternatives; more restrictive applicable limits prevail

concepts.purpose_scope_authority: Operational/safety prohibition independent of subscription membership
concepts.identity_lifecycle: ID; scope+reason+origin; active/released/expired for temporary holds
concepts.relationships: Endpoint invalidity, complaint safety hold, provider block, admin hold; release requires its own authorized evidence

concepts.purpose_scope_authority: Versioned rules and limits
concepts.relationships: Recipient restrictions and current safety rules can tighten prior campaign authority

concepts.purpose_scope_authority: One brand's purpose, approved facts, CTA and constraints; the brief and its concrete approved revisions are one concept
concepts.relationships: One brand and publication/purpose; channel representations; equivalence family

concepts.purpose_scope_authority: Channel-specific expression of one approved communication
concepts.relationships: Pinned content/theme/renderer/fact references; not auto-synchronized after approval

concepts.purpose_scope_authority: Controlled one-time audience communication program
concepts.relationships: Selection spec, sending authority, content, approval, schedule and recipient records

concepts.purpose_scope_authority: The V1 user-facing campaign type

concepts.relationships: Campaign with one communication occurrence

concepts.purpose_scope_authority: Restricted linear workflow optimized for operators
concepts.relationships: Ordered send/wait/condition steps; no separate orchestration engine

concepts.purpose_scope_authority: Membership/reentry identity for a profile in a sequence program

concepts.relationships: Links one authoritative execution; does not own a second step cursor

concepts.purpose_scope_authority: Event-driven bounded workflow definition

concepts.purpose_scope_authority: Durable authoritative cursor/context for either workflow kind
concepts.relationships: Current node, due time, pinned version, step executions, waits and delivery references

concepts.purpose_scope_authority: Frozen selection evidence for an occurrence
concepts.identity_lifecycle: Unique campaign occurrence/profile; selection fields immutable after finalization
concepts.relationships: Operational delivery progress is separate or an explicitly mutable projection

concepts.purpose_scope_authority: One subject's coordinated communication occurrence
concepts.relationships: Approved routes, decisions, reservations, one primary outbound delivery by default

concepts.purpose_scope_authority: One intended effect on one channel/endpoint
concepts.relationships: Exact payload/representation; attempts and independent outcome facts

concepts.purpose_scope_authority: One HTTP/transport interaction
concepts.relationships: Stable request or batch key and digest; attempts are not communications

concepts.purpose_scope_authority: Recognizable, verified sender within a brand and channel program
concepts.relationships: From/reply-to/domain or phone program; provider qualification and legal-sender map

concepts.purpose_scope_authority: Credential, region/team/account and quota boundary
concepts.relationships: Multiple sender bindings only if approved; does not own contact truth

concepts.purpose_scope_authority: Evidence of limits and behavior for a qualified route
concepts.relationships: Idempotency retention, batching, status retrieval, suppression and revocation scope, pricing, markets

concepts.purpose_scope_authority: Human-owned durable outcome and related-object context
concepts.relationships: Not permission, workflow cursor, verified purchase or autonomous mission

concepts.purpose_scope_authority: Typed bounds of an intended goal or proposal
concepts.relationships: Free text is not executable policy

concepts.purpose_scope_authority: Explicit user preference for explanation/style/defaults
concepts.relationships: Cannot weaken organization or recipient policy

concepts.purpose_scope_authority: Reviewable non-authoritative command candidates
concepts.relationships: “Approved” does not mean executed or indefinitely authorized

concepts.purpose_scope_authority: Required approver, scope and immutable candidate envelope
concepts.relationships: Not an approval record

concepts.purpose_scope_authority: Actual authenticated authority grant bound to a digest/envelope
concepts.identity_lifecycle: ID; principal, assurance, time, expiry, use policy; granted/consumed/invalidated/expired
concepts.relationships: AI or chat history cannot create it; same Approval concept as campaigns

concepts.purpose_scope_authority: Scoped conversational continuity and object refs
concepts.relationships: Not domain truth or long-lived delegation

concepts.purpose_scope_authority: Identifiable built-in intermediary or external machine principal
concepts.identity_lifecycle: Organization + opaque ID + issuer/client binding; pending/active/suspended/revoked
concepts.relationships: Not the human, not a recipient Person, not a provider credential

concepts.purpose_scope_authority: Narrow authorization from a human/authority to an agent
concepts.identity_lifecycle: ID + revision, principal chain, workspace/resources/commands, budget/time; proposed/active/expired/revoked
concepts.relationships: Cannot exceed delegator's current effective authority or approve itself

concepts.purpose_scope_authority: Bounded operational run and checkpoints under a grant
concepts.relationships: Not AutomationExecution; no second messaging workflow runtime

concepts.purpose_scope_authority: A typed command item inside Proposal or an attention item
concepts.identity_lifecycle: Proposal revision + item ID; derived from proposal/command result
concepts.relationships: Not a new project-management task system

concepts.purpose_scope_authority: Ordered proposal commands and linked goal artifacts
concepts.identity_lifecycle: Versioned proposal data initially; proposal lifecycle
concepts.relationships: A general planning subsystem is deferred

concepts.purpose_scope_authority: Recorded command/execution result or observed business outcome
concepts.identity_lifecycle: Command/run/receipt/event IDs; facts plus correction events
concepts.relationships: Observation is not causation
